name: Traccia — Real-Time Crisis Monitoring & User Onboarding Pipeline

meta.description: Production automation pipeline for Traccia. Section 1 (nodes 1-8): polls the FastAPI sentiment engine every 30s, evaluates statistical anomalies via Z-score (Z >= 2.5), and escalates confirmed crises to Slack, email, and PostgreSQL. Section 2 (nodes 9-12): handles new user registrations from the dashboard site and sends a welcome email.

nodes.name: 1. Scheduled Poll (Every 30s)
nodes.notes: Triggers the monitoring cycle every 30 seconds, matching the ingestion cadence documented in background_tasks.py.

nodes.name: 2. Fetch Live Sentiment Stats
nodes.notes: Calls the FastAPI backend at http://localhost:8000/api/current_sentiment for Z-score, sentiment breakdown, and crisis level.

nodes.name: 3. Backend Reachable?
nodes.notes: Guards against silent failures if the FastAPI service is down or unreachable.

parameters.text: ⚠️ Traccia Backend Unreachable — scheduled health poll failed. Please check FastAPI service status and container logs.

nodes.name: 4a. Notify Engineering (Backend Down)
nodes.notes: Infrastructure-level alert, separate from brand-sentiment crisis alerts, so on-call engineers aren't confused with a marketing/PR issue.

nodes.name: 4b. Z-Score Exceeds Crisis Threshold (2.5s)
nodes.notes: Statistical anomaly gate - matches the 2.5 standard-deviation threshold used in crisis_detector.py (99.4% confidence level).

nodes.name: 5. Retrieve Crisis Context
nodes.notes: Pulls supporting detail (root cause, negative-spike %) to enrich the alert instead of sending a bare number.

parameters.query: INSERT INTO crisis_alerts (id, timestamp, severity, title, z_score, negative_spike_pct, status) VALUES (gen_random_uuid()::text, NOW(), '{{$json.stats.activeCrisisLevel}}', 'Automated anomaly detection', {{$json.stats.zScore}}, {{$json.stats.negativePct}}, 'ACTIVE');

nodes.name: 6. Log Crisis to PostgreSQL
nodes.notes: Persists the anomaly for historical trend analysis and the dashboard's Crisis Alerts tab.

parameters.text:
🚨 TRACCIA BRAND CRISIS DETECTED
Severity: {{$json.stats.activeCrisisLevel}}
Z-score: {{$json.stats.zScore}}s (threshold: 2.5s)
Negative sentiment: {{$json.stats.negativePct}}%
Dashboard: http://localhost:5173
Action required: review live comment feed and prepare response.

nodes.name: 7. Slack Crisis Room Alert
nodes.notes: Primary real-time channel for the response team.

parameters.subject: Traccia Crisis Alert - {{$json.stats.activeCrisisLevel}} severity
parameters.html:
Brand Sentiment Crisis Detected

Severity{{$json.stats.activeCrisisLevel}}
Z-score{{$json.stats.zScore}}s (threshold 2.5s)
Negative sentiment{{$json.stats.negativePct}}%

Open live dashboard

This is an automated alert from the Traccia monitoring pipeline.

nodes.name: 8. Email Leadership Digest
nodes.notes: Formal record for stakeholders who don't monitor Slack in real time. CRISIS_EMAIL_LIST is set via environment variable.

nodes.name: 9. Registration Webhook (Dashboard Sign-Up)
nodes.notes: Called by the dashboard/site when a new user registers.

nodes.name: 10. Email Address Provided?
nodes.notes: Basic input validation before attempting DB write or email send.

parameters.subject: Welcome to Traccia
parameters.html:
Welcome, {{$json.body.name || 'there'}}

Your Traccia account is active. You now have access to real-time brand sentiment tracking and automated crisis detection.

Open your dashboard

If you have any questions, simply reply to this email.

- The Traccia Team

nodes.name: 11a. Send Welcome Email
nodes.notes: Professional onboarding email - states what the product does and where to go next.

parameters.query: INSERT INTO users (email, name, registered_at) VALUES ('{{$json.body.email}}', '{{$json.body.name}}', NOW()) ON CONFLICT (email) DO NOTHING;

nodes.name: 11b. Log Registration to PostgreSQL
nodes.notes: Logs registered user to PostgreSQL users table.

parameters.responseBody: ={ "status": "error", "message": "A valid email address is required to register." }

nodes.name: 12. Respond Missing Email
nodes.notes: Returns a clear error instead of failing silently.
